Rent your furnished property to companies

Professional tenants, stays agreed in advance and one point of contact: join Eden Corporate Mobility's housing network.

What we look for

We visit and select every property before offering it to our clients.

Ready-to-live-in furnished homes
Studios, one-bedrooms and larger, fully equipped, in Paris and the inner suburbs, close to public transport.
Availability from a few weeks to several months
Our clients need mid-length stays: ideal if your property is free between tenants or for part of the year.
Responsive owners
A careful inventory, a well-maintained property and a quick answer when we reach out.

What you gain

Identified occupants, employees of client companies, with stay dates agreed in advance. A professional contact for the whole stay, handling arrivals, departures and day-to-day questions. And a property occupied by people who are here to work.

Call us or describe your property through the form: we will get back to you quickly and explain how we work.

Sending people to Paris? Call us.

In ten minutes we will understand your needs and tell you what we can do. In English or French, no commitment.
